verdict.rationale: Alma documents itself as an immigration law firm whose core service is attorney-led petition preparation: a dedicated attorney per case, a guaranteed 2-week case-preparation turnaround once evidence is collected, portal questionnaires, and RFE responses included. However, the specific end-to-end components in the story are not itemized anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Alma assembles the evidence binder, drafts expert/support letters, completes the forms, and handles the USCIS filing, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: Every case is led by a dedicated attorney
Alma is a modern immigration law firm that structures agent-sponsored O-1 petitions
Alma guarantees a 2-week case-preparation turnaround once evidence collection is complete
Complete online questionnaires on Alma’s portal
Alma's immigration legal services help founders identify and execute optimal visa strategies
